source: UI design package supplied by the user
tokens: tokens.json contains the supplied theme values; authoritative source for runtime and generation
fonts: Seven original IBM Plex WOFF2 files copied unchanged; native Godot FontFile import, no conversion
font_license: fonts/OFL.txt; exact OFL text also embedded in the generated Theme for exported resource-only builds
packaging: Generated Theme embeds exact tokens.json text; runtime uses it only when the source JSON is absent in an exported build
glyphs: Six original 16px status SVG files copied unchanged
tracking: Godot FontVariation spacing_glyph uses integer pixels; em values rounded at the logical token size (section 1px, tag 0px, display 0px)
line_height: Label line_spacing is the token lineHeight minus the imported font height; apply_label also sets logical minimum height and uppercase for section/tag
